tests.question: How many new avails were created this month?
tests.validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as answer FROM core_dev.techops.avails_status_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM core_dev.techops.avails_status_snapshot) AND inserted_at >= date_trunc('month', current_date())

tests.question: How many new avails were created this month broken down by content type?

tests.question: How many avails are currently in pending review status?

tests.question: How many titles were imported last month?

tests.question: How many titles were imported last month by content type?
tests.validation_sql: SELECT content_type, SUM(count) as count FROM core_dev.techops.imported_titles_monthly WHERE month = date_trunc('month', dateadd(MONTH, -1, current_date())) GROUP BY content_type

tests.question: How many titles were imported this month?

tests.question: How many titles did the Ops team review this month?

tests.question: How many total QA reviews were completed this month?

tests.question: How many titles are in the ABF review queue right now?

tests.question: How many titles are currently in internal review?

tests.question: How many open redeliveries are there right now?

tests.question: How many open redeliveries are there by asset type?
tests.validation_sql: SELECT modality, COUNT(*) as count FROM core_dev.techops.redeliveries WHERE dismissed = false AND is_active_redelivery = true GROUP BY modality

tests.question: How many redeliveries were created this week?

tests.validation_sql: SELECT import_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM core_dev.techops.redeliveries WHERE dismissed = false AND is_active_redelivery = true GROUP BY import_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

tests.question: How many active content partners do we have?

tests.question: How many reviews did each team complete last month?

tests.question: How many distinct content IDs have an open redelivery?

tests.question: How many titles are ready to publish in the content refresh pipeline?
